descricao_original: This image shows another alveolus attached to an alveolar duct, as indicated by the presence of smooth muscle knobs. Note the large numbers of capillaries in the septum that bulge into the alveolar space. The alveolus is lined by a thin epithelium of Type I cells which, along with the endothelium of the capillaries, form the air-blood barrier. Toluidine blue, 1000x
